flash: Complete factory image written and all regions verified by esptool.
firmware_change: Raise GPIO46 power hold at the start of app_main; initialize GPIO38 Stamp S3A status LED power off and switch it on only while RMT output is enabled.
followup_status_pixel_check: With the user reporting a visible light, COM9 still read enabled=false. A saved dim-red (brightness 16, red 128) frame was briefly enabled; applied_frames=1. The output was then disabled again and COM9 confirmed enabled=false. User visual comparison is pending.
remaining: The test addressed a single status LED on the Stamp S3A module. It did not test the M5Dial's circular display or encoder ring. The user later reported a visible light while serial control still reported output enabled=false; the source of that light is not confirmed.
Battery powered retention, display, encoder, touch, RFID, and Gate B/C qualification are not yet demonstrated.
